dataset: SGL 2020 MagNav Challenge (USAF Cooperative Agreement FA8750-19-2-1000; Gnadt et al. arXiv:2007.12158); maps from MagNav.jl (ottawa_area_maps)

data/map_eastern_395.npz.info: Eastern Ontario magnetic anomaly map upward continued to 395 m above WGS-84 Ellipsoid. Flown and compiled near Ottawa, Ontario, Canada (UTM Zone 18N) by Sander Geophysics Ltd. (SGL). Filled in using k-nearest neighbors (k=3). Processed using MagNav.jl v1.2.0.

data/map_synth_100m.npz.label: synthetic map (sensitivity study), not survey data
notes: Depth to source z0 = 0 is a disclosed modelling choice; residual curvature of the real-tile spectrum below 750 m wavelength hints at a depth of about 100-150 m.
The joint (beta, h) fit is degenerate (beta 0.92 at h 543 m for this band) and was rejected; beta is fitted with h fixed at the tile's stored 395 m.
Power below 600 m wavelength is an extrapolation of the fitted power law.
The frozen motor amplitude A1 = 3600 nT came from the 0.6 x median window-std rule evaluated on the real 400 m world and is not re-evaluated for this map.
The npz is the source of truth; in-page regeneration is not bit-reproducible across platforms.
